mcp_tools.name: assumption_audit
mcp_tools.title: Assumption audit
mcp_tools.description: Submit a decision-process evidence manifest; get a deterministic SOUND / UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections (framing, preset criteria, loss function, rigor sizing, data discipline, review) with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The decision-process evidence manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

framing.description: Framing evidence (decision named, options, decision-maker, objective).

preset.description: Preset-criteria evidence (criteria, default action, change-my-mind threshold — all set before data).

loss.description: Loss-function evidence (cost of wrong in each direction, asymmetry in the threshold).

data.description: Data-discipline evidence (exploratory vs confirmatory, roles clear).

review.description: Review evidence (decision quality reviewed separately from outcome).

expect.notes: All 18 boolean fields set to true; verdict should be SOUND.

checks.evidence: name the decision and the real options
the real options are listed, not a single foregone option
what the decision-maker actually cares about (the objective / loss function) is defined
decide how to decide before you see the data — decision criteria set in advance
pre-commit to exactly what evidence would flip the default — answered before looking
what being wrong costs — in each direction
reversible decisions decide fast; irreversible ones slow down and gather more
exploratory analysis generates hypotheses; confirmatory analysis tests a pre-registered hypothesis
never draw a conclusion from the same data that inspired it
if no possible data could change the action, the data is decoration
the decision-maker frames and defines thresholds; the analyst informs — analysis does not quietly make the call
review the decision after acting per the pre-set criteria
judge a decision by the process and information at the time, not by how it turned out (no resulting)
